senses.gloss:
अणि, इस्, m. or अणी, f. the point of a needle; the
linch-pin; the pin or bolt at the end of the pole of
a carriage; the corner or part of a house which serves
for slaughtering; a bound, boundary, limit.
—अणी-
माण्डव्य, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi said to have been
impaled on an अणि or linch-pin.

आणि आणि, इस्, m. f. [cf. अणि], the pin of the
axle of a cart, the linch-pin; the part of the leg just
above the knee; the corner of a house; a limit, a
boundary; the edge of a sword.

अणिमन्, आ, m. (fr. अणु, q. v.), minuteness, fine-
ness, thinness; atomic nature; the superhuman power
of becoming as small as an atom; (अ), n., Ved. the
smallest particle.
अणिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अणु, q. v.), most minute.

अणीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (fr. अणु, q. v.), or अणीयस्क,
अस्, आ, अम्, more minute than usual.
